title: Quasi-pointed exactness and torsion
summary: We show that, under some mild assumptions, every quasi-pointed category C carries a canonical near-torsion theory (T,F), where T consists of the 0-supported objects, that is, those admitting a morphism to the initial object 0, and F consists of the subterminal objects. The coreflection and the reflection of an object A are then given by the projection $A \times 0 \to A$ and by the strong-epimorphic part of $A \to 1$, respectively.
